title: FABP5 regulates an immunosuppressive microenvironment in hepatocellular carcinoma through the NF-kappaB/PD-L1 axis.
authors: An, Rui; Hou, Shibing; Hong, Min; Zhen, Jiaorong; Wang, Zhijuan; Huang, Haoming; Zhao, Weixuan; Liao, Mianmian; Yuan, Weiqu; Huang, Danping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FABP5通过NF-kappaB/PD-L1轴调控肝癌免疫微环境，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白对接和MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象偏离TF-DNA体系。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Fatty acid binding protein 5 (FABP5) contributes to lipid metabolism and inflammation, but, its immunoregulatory role in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is unclear. Considering the strong metabolic-immune interplay in HCC, elucidating how FABP5 shapes the tumor immune microenvironment may uncover new therapeutic targets. METHODS: TCGA, CCLE and single-cell RNA-seq datasets were employed to characterize FABP5 expression and clinical relevance. FABP5 knockdown was performed to assess effects on HCC cell proliferation. Immune infiltration, immune checkpoint profiles, TIDE scores and enrichment of immune-related pathways were analyzed. Differentially expressed genes underwent GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analyses. Protein-protein docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and in vitro assays were conducted to explore the regulatory role of FABP5 in the NF-kappaB/PD-L1 axis. Drug screening, molecular docking and duplicate MD simulations were carried out to identify potential FABP5-targeting compounds. RESULTS: FABP5 was significantly upregulated in HCC and predicted worse survival, serving as an independent prognostic factor. Single-cell analysis identified predominant FABP5 expression in fibroblasts and macrophages. FABP5 knockdown suppressed cell proliferation, colony formation, DNA synthesis and migration, accompanied by decreased expression of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) markers. FABP5-high tumors exhibited increased immune infiltration but raised immune checkpoint levels and higher TIDE scores, indicative of an immunosuppressive microenvironment. FABP5 correlated positively with NF-kappaB pathway genes and molecular docking predicted stable complexes between IkappaBalpha and P65. Experimental validation confirmed that FABP5 drives PD-L1 upregulation in an NF-kappaB-dependent manner. Drug screening identified CZS-241 as the most promising FABP5-binding candidate, and duplicate MD simulations demonstrated a stable FABP5-CZS-241 complex. CONCLUSION: FABP5 drives immunosuppression in HCC by inducing PD-L1 via the NF-kappaB pathway. CZS-241 is identified as a promising FABP5-targeting compound with therapeutic potential for HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：脂肪酸结合蛋白5（FABP5）参与脂质代谢和炎症，但其在肝细胞癌（HCC）中的免疫调节作用尚不清楚。鉴于HCC中代谢-免疫的强相互作用，阐明FABP5如何塑造肿瘤免疫微环境可能揭示新的治疗靶点。方法：利用TCGA、CCLE和单细胞RNA-seq数据集表征FABP5表达及其临床相关性。通过FABP5敲低评估其对HCC细胞增殖的影响。分析免疫浸润、免疫检查点谱、TIDE评分及免疫相关通路富集情况。对差异表达基因进行GO和KEGG通路富集分析。采用蛋白质-蛋白质对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和体外实验探讨FABP5在NF-kappaB/PD-L1轴中的调控作用。进行药物筛选、分子对接和重复MD模拟以识别潜在的FABP5靶向化合物。结果：FABP5在HCC中显著上调，并预测更差的生存期，作为独立预后因素。单细胞分析鉴定FABP5主要在成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞中表达。FABP5敲低抑制细胞增殖、集落形成、DNA合成和迁移，伴随上皮-间质转化（epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT）标志物表达下降。FABP5高表达肿瘤表现出免疫浸润增加，但免疫检查点水平升高和TIDE评分更高，提示免疫抑制微环境。FABP5与NF-kappaB通路基因正相关，分子对接预测IkappaBalpha和P65之间形成稳定复合物。实验验证确认FABP5以NF-kappaB依赖性方式驱动PD-L1上调。药物筛选鉴定CZS-241为最有前景的FABP5结合候选物，重复MD模拟显示FABP5-CZS-241复合物稳定。结论：FABP5通过NF-kappaB通路诱导PD-L1驱动HCC免疫抑制。CZS-241被鉴定为有前景的FABP5靶向化合物，具有HCC治疗潜力。
